CustomField.description: When checked, exposes the New (add row) action on Repeater and Table sections. Passed as allow-new to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table. The button text comes from New Action Button Label; for Table sections the add modal uses Table New Action Modal Title/Subtitle.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to let users add new rows to this repeater or table. Set the button wording with New Action Button Label, and (for tables) the add modal text with the Table New Action Modal fields.
CustomField.label: Enable New Action
